title: Kit Virtual File System UI
description: Add unified FileSystemNode interface with computed parent/children/path across GraphQL golden schema, Rust store, and semio/js. Wire folder membership storage and createFolder/moveToFolder via existing kit operation mechanism.
summary: Added VirtualFileSystem UI component (specialized hierarchical Table with expand/collapse and drag-drop) in @ui/react with buildVirtualFileSystemVisibleRows helper and vitest coverage. Created Storybook stories (Collapsed, Expanded, StaticRows). Extended @framework/platform/core with virtualFileSystem component kind, VirtualFileSystemModel, VirtualFileSystemController (lazy child loading for expanded nodes only), PlatformVirtualFileSystemDemoController, and registerPlatformVirtualFileSystemDemo. Wired BuiltinVirtualFileSystemKindRenderer in @framework/platform/renderer/react with expand, selection, and drag-reparent commands. All platform core (11), ui react (76), and platform renderer (19) tests pass.
